title: finding
description: Origin: v2 §17. Owned by the finding service (U9). `state` is the canonical lifecycle machine; an unknown state is rejected. A failed enrichment must never erase a valid first-stage finding — ENRICHMENT_FAILED is a terminal-eligible state, not a drop.

intel_tlp.comment: FIRST TLP 2.0 marking set (§12.1). Restricts export/sharing; red is never exportable.

intel_source_trust.comment: Per-feed trust weight (0=untrusted .. 1=fully trusted). A low-trust feed cannot override a high-trust indicator's score.

expiry.comment: This source's assertion validity; the lifecycle selects effective scores only from currently-valid assertions.

disposition.comment: active while live; expired once past expiry; suppressed while an auditable, expiring suppression is in force.

intel_match.description: U2 live indicator with effective U1 score, trust, marking and full provenance. Suppressed and TLP:red hits are stored in the local intel audit instead of emitted as candidates. No file-hash source is available.

entities.description: Typed entity objects (ip/domain/fingerprint/…). Detectors emit this as a JSON-serialized string on the wire (parsed by downstream consumers and the ClickHouse/SIEM boundary); the raw array form is also accepted.

summary.description: Central-enrichment (Zeek) summary merged onto the finding on ENRICHED (U11): bounded conn/tls/x509/http/ssh/file/smb/kerberos rollups. Producer-bounded (details capped); absent unless enrichment succeeded.

iocs.description: Indicators extracted from the enrichment summary (file hashes, ja3/ja4/ja4s/ja4h/ja4ssh, self-signed certs). Lists are unioned across enrichments; absent unless enrichment succeeded.

source_events.description: Provenance (baseline tier): the originating Suricata EVE record(s) that produced this finding, so the SIEM document is self-describing. Each entry is {event_type, community_id?, flow_id?, tx_id?, timestamp, record} where `record` is the native EVE object (verbatim, bounded by NDR_SOURCE_EVENTS_MAX_BYTES; truncated:true + preview on overflow). Single/few-record findings inline the record(s); aggregates carry a representative entry plus a `contributors` summary {count, community_ids[], flow_ids[]}. Additive: never read by detection/scoring/lifecycle; absent identifiers are omitted, never fabricated.

enrichment_state.description: PENDING = a confirmed threat was delivered (deliver-now) and its evidence is still being captured; TIMEOUT = the capture never completed (no overlay, refusal, or timeout) but the finding was still delivered, not dropped (U1/F01).
